evidence.quote:
The old `LOCAL_ADDRESS` bucket was too coarse. The 183 events split cleanly
enough to support the mixed system we have been looking for:

| reading tier | events | interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| exact running formula | 61 | identical surface has one invariant recipe in running text |
| attested recipe under a new surface | 7 | minimal segmentation reproduces an observed recipe |
| short/repeated provisional composition | 8 | bounded new composition; factor reader does not stop |
| learned whole nomenclator label | 107 | owner-bound object/station/name card |

Thus 76 events (55 surfaces) carry address formulae, while 107 events (107
surfaces) are learned whole labels. All retained whole labels are singletons in
this address set. That singleton tail is not a failure of the compositional
model: it is exactly the learned nomenclator layer expected beside a compact
technical code.

## What the whole labels denote

The image owner supplies a concrete class, but not the missing individual
identity:

- 64 stellar-position labels on `f71v`/`f72r` → `STERNSTELLENNAME`;
- 35 drug or ingredient labels on `f88v`/`f89r` → `DROGENNAME`;
- 6 bath/outlet-station labels on `f77r` → `BADSTATIONSNAME`;
- 2 labels beside the pictured flowering plant on `f17r` → `PFLANZENNAME`.

These are short defaults for what kind of learned entry the card is, not claims

## Architectural consequence

This establishes a historically real alternative for q13 graphical text:
some diagram-local strings could function as references into explanatory prose
or as component/state keys, not as ordinary object names.  That alternative is
more compatible with q13's mixed labels/prose and weak one-object ownership
than a naive label dictionary.

It does **not** pass its Voynich prediction.  GDT187 already found that exact
PAGE_HOST reuse between label inventories and same-page prose is sparse but
not exceptional: 57/215 label occurrences appear anywhere in same-page prose,
22/215 at paragraph openings, and the ten-channel adjusted result is

| 1 | M02 `chor` flower / `shor` seed-fruit | 0.820437 | 0 | tied direction; no replacement |
| 1 | M03 reverse direction | 0.820437 | 0 | tied direction; no replacement |
| 3 | M01 same part, dry/moist | 0.644178 | 0 | live rival; persistence failed |
| 4 | M04 general herb / reproductive | 0.631987 | 0 | live rival; breadth failed |
| 5 | M05 role-distinct learned wholes | 0.132523 | 0 | disfavored; divergence failed |

Every feature-by-model row contains its score, evidence, and counterevidence.
The two leaders have identical weighted sums (9.024812/11) because flower and
seed/fruit identity credit is fixed to zero. Their high tied score supports the
shared two-part architecture; it does not satisfy either directional minimum.

Die 109 gelernten Inhaltsoccurrences haben jetzt eine konkretere und
zusammensetzbarere Basis. GDT585 ändert keine Grenze und kein produktives
GDT582-Wort. Es ersetzt nur die Namensschicht: 107 feste GDT581-Namensslots
plus zwei ownergebundene `LOCAL_X`-Inhalte.

| Schicht | Occurrences | Typen/Karten |
|---|---:|---:|
| Stern-/Ringwerte | 60 | 43 |
| Drogen-/Zutatenobjekte | 38 | 29 |
| Bad-/Auslassstationen | 7 | 6 |
| eine abgebildete Pflanze | 2 | 2 |
| ownergebundene `LOCAL_X`-Inhalte | 2 | 2 |
| **Gesamt** | **109** | **82 einschließlich `LOCAL_X`** |

Die 107 eigentlichen Namensslots liegen in 89 Labels. Sie erzeugen zusammen
mit einem Same-owner-Pflanzenbundle und einem optischen Zweizeilenpaar 19
explizite Compound-/Gruppenlesungen. Fünf Familienkarten verbinden die
stärksten wiederkehrenden Muster.

root_qualifications: The sketches have no complete new declared design. Related-source overlap and absence of a specified changed contrast justify not adding them to the active raw queue here; this is not proof of formal identity of every possible mechanism in those broad families.

GDT459 splits 183 address events by inherited recipe and owner-class rules (61 exact,7 attested-recipe,8 provisional,107 learned whole). Those are model/source classifications, not an independent test proving portable meanings against all naming.

GDT214 motivates a component-key convention with an external hydraulic comparator, while its cited label/prose reuse test is nonconfirming. This does not globally refute component/state keys; existing IDEA39 remains a distinct explicitly untested design.
GDT768 records a directional tie and source-model preferences, not independent flower/seed word identification. No revised directional falsifier is supplied by the IN sketch.
GDT585 constructs a name/content atlas over fixed slots. More detailed atlas completion is not itself a newly discriminating meaning test.
